cell_measures.name: stability_seed
cell_measures.description: consensus stability over seed replicates only (mean over configurations)

models.json.description: Per-model factor levels, metrics (raw/scaled), aggregates, seed-replicate sd, 2D model-map coordinates per measure mode, summary measures. Order = manifest.model_order.

agreement.bin.description: A(a,b) = mean Δ over a stratified sample of 1999 cells (measure: jaccard)

agreement_composition.bin.description: A(a,b) = mean Δ over a stratified sample of 1999 cells (measure: composition)

cells.json.description: Per cell: id, fixed-map x/y (UMAP of the consensus kNN graph; location only), dictionary-encoded obs columns, numeric QC columns, planted-effect membership.

cell_measures.bin.description: per-cell measure arrays; array names in manifest.cell_measures

pair_delta.bin.description: seed-averaged Δ̄ per cell and matched one-factor pair (measure jaccard)

pair_delta_composition.bin.description: seed-averaged Δ̄ per cell and matched one-factor pair (measure composition)

z_vs_ref.bin.description: calibrated change z(c, ref, model), measure jaccard

z_vs_ref_composition.bin.description: calibrated change z(c, ref, model) for the first reference only, measure composition

regions.json.description: Per measure mode: regions with size, compositions, QC summaries, top genes, mean E/H, and the local variant of every model (arrays in manifest.model_order).

neighbors_sample.bin.description: k=15 nearest-neighbour indices for the models in manifest.neighbor_models

umap_models.bin.description: per-embedding UMAP (scanpy neighbors on the model's latent + tl.umap), quantised: x = min + q/65535*(max-min) with min/max per model in manifest.umap_models; visual QC only
